newsitem.title: UK: Alliance says to acquire LaTex of U.S.
newsitem.headline: Alliance says to acquire LaTex of U.S.

text.p: Britain's Alliance Resources Plc said on Monday that it was planning to acquire U.S. oil and gas exploration firm LaTex Resources.
The consideration will be paid through an issue of 21.45 million shares, aggregating 17.2 million stg and warrants to subscribe for up to 1.9 million shares in Alliance.
A spokesman for the company said the warrants would be priced at 40 pence a share totalling 771,163 stg.
LaTex, the shares of which are traded on Nasdaq is an independent oil and gas company based in Tulsa in Oklahoma.
The company owns and operates reserves in 13 states in the U.S. including Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma and Texas.
